headline: General Motors Shares Fall as Full-Year Profit Forecast Misses Estimates
summary: General Motors reported a sharp rise in third-quarter core profit driven by pickup truck sales, but its shares declined after its full-year earnings-per-share forecast missed analyst estimates.
why: Automotive manufacturers rely heavily on sustained truck and vehicle demand, and discrepancies between guidance and analyst estimates frequently trigger immediate share price corrections.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected full-year profit guidance disappointed investors, sending shares lower despite solid quarterly earnings.

why_moved: GM's share price dropped because its forward-looking earnings guidance fell short of Wall Street's consensus expectations.
